verdict.rationale: Mixpanel ships AI agents, so letting users connect external MCP servers for those agents to call is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Mixpanel's own hosted MCP server, which exposes Mixpanel data to outside AI assistants. That is the server role, not the client capability this story asks about. Nothing in the pack shows users can plug third-party MCP servers into Mixpanel.
